method: Every row is classified from data already in the repository: the root-family rule (family:merged rows are documentation, not headwords), the reviewed curation map (docs/vocabulary-curation.json replayed through scripts/vocabulary_curation.py), the editorial CEFR level tags, and the curriculum words transcribed in docs/curriculum-grades-6-9.json. The audit writes no vocabulary data.

limits: The CEFR level of a row is an editorial tag, not a curriculum mapping; the audit reports it, it does not re-derive it.

Curriculum words were transcribed from third-party reproductions of the Global Success series; grades 6 and 7 are topic-level only because the retrieved teacher-training documents publish no per-unit word table.
Exam attestation counts come from the repository's own transcription corpus and are not evidence that a word is worth teaching.
Vietnamese gloss semantics were not re-edited; the audit only flags a gloss that repeats the headword.
